premises.text: Professionals struggle to stand out in job applications
premises.evidence_span: How can I make myself stand out above everyone else?

premises.text: Guild allows professionals to compete and connect to advance their careers
premises.evidence_span: Guild is where social gaming meets career advancement for technology professionals.

premises.text: Competitions on Guild are sponsored by companies and are low stakes
premises.evidence_span: Competitions are sponsored by companies, they're low stakes

premises.text: Guild recommends skills based on user activity
premises.evidence_span: Guild is recommending skills that I may want to add to my repertoire.

premises.text: Guild provides feedback on job applications to improve chances of success
premises.evidence_span: I want feedback. I want to know what are my chances of actually landing a job here or an interview.

premises.text: Employers can find and invite passive job seekers through Guild
premises.evidence_span: if someone really catches my eye, I can invite them.

premises.text: Guild connects professionals and employers directly without third parties
premises.evidence_span: Guild is a place for professionals and employers to connect directly. No third parties, no agencies on Guild.

value.text: Professionals can advance their careers through competitions and direct connections with employers
value.evidence_span: Guild helps professionals advance their careers in ways that haven't been done before.

notes: Beta status and user sign-up count are excluded as traction.
